label: FAIL-ALARM-EXTERNAL-DELIVERY-001
symptom: Internal alarm emission passes but external delivery is BLOCKED_NO_BOUND_NEXY_MONITORING_PLATFORM.
root_cause: No external monitoring sink is bound.

label: FAIL-AUTH-OTAC-ABUSE-001
symptom: Expired/reused/device-mismatched/brute-forced OTAC is denied and may emit security incident/alarm.
root_cause: Auth token lifetime/use/attempt/device constraints violated.

label: FAIL-AUTH-SESSION-CAP-001
symptom: Oldest non-OWNER session is revoked; if all active sessions are OWNER and new OWNER requested, SESSION_CAP_REACHED/SESSION_REVOKED error.
root_cause: Concurrent session cap is exhausted.

label: FAIL-AUTO-RECOVERY-ESCALATION-001
symptom: Playbook attempts exceed escalateAfterAttempts and result becomes ESCALATED.
root_cause: Repeated remediation failure.

label: FAIL-DISPATCH-DUPLICATE-001
symptom: Duplicate job is acknowledged as CANCELLED or already completed instead of re-running swarm.
root_cause: Dispatch record is already processing/completed.

label: FAIL-DOC-E-ACTIONS-NO-STEPS-001
symptom: Jobs completed/failure with steps=null; checkout/commands never ran; some log retrieval returned BlobNotFound.
root_cause: Hosted runner/environment failure before test execution.

label: FAIL-EVIDENCE-STALE-HEAD-001
symptom: Evidence artifacts exist but are revision-stale for current HEAD.
root_cause: Evidence freshness mismatch.

label: FAIL-FREEZE-ORPHAN-001
symptom: In-memory FREEZE exists without FreezeIncident/AuditLog linkage.
root_cause: Caller used buildFreezeEnvelope without required SERIALIZABLE persistence transaction.

label: FAIL-FREEZE-RECOVERY-DENIED-001
symptom: Recovery denied because reason is non-recoverable or actor not OWNER/SYSTEM as allowed.
root_cause: Freeze reason catalog/authorization guard rejects recovery.

label: FAIL-INVALID-FSM-001
symptom: STATE_TRANSITION_DENIED or actor ownership violation.
root_cause: Event not legal from current state or actor does not own event.

label: FAIL-MANDATORY-AUDIT-PERSIST-001
symptom: Persistence of mandatory incident/audit evidence itself fails; worker emits MANDATORY_AUDIT_PERSISTENCE_FAILURE.
root_cause: Database/transaction failure while recording required safety evidence.

label: FAIL-MIGRATION-ROUNDTRIP-BLOCKED-001
symptom: Current migration forward/rollback/forward did not run because isolated PostgreSQL Actions job had steps=null.
root_cause: Execution environment unavailable.

label: FAIL-QUEUE-E7-BLOCKED-001
symptom: Real Redis/BullMQ/PostgreSQL producer+worker gate did not execute on current revision.
root_cause: Hosted isolated runner failed before services/steps.

label: FAIL-QUEUE-REDIS-AOF-001
symptom: REDIS_AOF_DISABLED causes CRITICAL WORKER_DOWN alarm and process exit.
root_cause: Redis persistence is not configured appendonly=yes.

label: FAIL-QUEUE-SCHEMA-001
symptom: SchemaViolationError / SCHEMA_VIOLATION.
root_cause: Queue payload does not conform to canonical DirectiveJobSchema or producer idempotency key mismatches.

label: FAIL-QUEUE-STALE-JOB-001
symptom: Job throws [EXPIRED] after stale_job_ttl_ms.
root_cause: Enqueued job age exceeded configured stale-job TTL.

label: FAIL-RECOVERY-CRASH-LOOP-001
symptom: Crash count reaches configured loop limit and runtime switches to SAFE_RUNTIME; directives become unacceptable.
root_cause: Repeated process failures within crash window.

label: FAIL-RECOVERY-HASH-MISMATCH-001
symptom: Persisted final event hash does not equal current WAL hash.
root_cause: Restart state does not match sealed pre-death history.

label: FAIL-RECOVERY-MEMORY-PRESSURE-001
symptom: Memory ratio > 0.92 triggers pre-death seal and process exit.
root_cause: Critical OOM risk.

label: FAIL-RELEASE-POLICY-REJECT-001
symptom: LAW release gate returns passed=false; run becomes FREEZE/REJECTED and incident/audit are recorded.
root_cause: One or more release invariants fail: acceptance, deterministic threshold, quorum, critical-agent state, LAW check/evidence.

label: FAIL-RELEASE-SIGNOFF-001
symptom: No authorized engineering/security/migration signoffs; PR remains DRAFT/NON_DEPLOYABLE.
root_cause: External human authorization is absent.

label: FAIL-VAULT-OCC-001
symptom: VAULT_COMMIT_CONFLICT / optimistic concurrency conflict.
root_cause: previous_version or revision sequence no longer matches current artifact state.

label: Capability history is append-only
statement: Activated capability/rejection-code history is versioned/append-only; semantic changes create new version or deprecation, not rewrite.

label: Chaos ledger remains bounded
statement: Chaos/fuzz execution must preserve declared ledger/resource boundedness.

label: Chaos cannot leave state divergence
statement: Equivalent deterministic chaos inputs must not leave authoritative state divergence.

label: Chaos cannot produce double credit
statement: No chaos/adversarial path may create duplicate economic credit/spend.

label: Canonical event order is explicit FIFO
statement: Canonical async/event processing uses explicit deterministic ordering; unordered future completion cannot alter canonical state.

label: Integrity over availability
statement: When availability conflicts with constitutional integrity, integrity wins.

label: Canonical Core excludes FP/RNG/system clock
statement: Canonical Core authority excludes floating point, uncontrolled RNG and system-clock dependence; overflow freezes.

label: Recursive sandbox cannot escalate
statement: Child recursive sandbox tier strictly increases and child permissions/resources are subset of parent; maximum depth is bounded.

label: Single canonical mutator
statement: Canonical Core state has exactly one deterministic mutator/executor and no parallel shared mutable canonical state.

label: Snapshot activation is two-phase and durable
statement: Snapshot becomes authoritative only after complete serialize/hash/write/fsync/activation sequence.

label: WAL durability precedes mutation ACK
statement: Canonical mutation order is serialize→append WAL→fsync→mutate memory→ACK with hash-linked WAL integrity.

label: Backend authorization is mandatory
statement: Role/UI visibility never replaces backend authorization for privileged actions.

label: FREEZE blocks release and ordinary execution
statement: Authoritative FREEZE blocks output release/new ordinary execution and invalidates pending release authorization.

label: Execution state changes only by legal transition
statement: DOC-C execution state changes only through its explicit event/actor/guard transition table.

label: Duplicate mutation must not duplicate effect
statement: A repeated mutation carrying the same idempotency identity must not create a second authoritative effect.

label: Committed Vault history is append-only
statement: Committed revision history cannot be overwritten in place; content mutation creates a new revision and preserves lineage.

label: Game client is never authoritative
statement: Client prediction/input cannot directly mutate sovereign game state.

label: Cross-shard entity cannot be authoritative twice
statement: Cross-shard transfer preserves single authoritative ownership/value using EXPORT→COMMIT→IMPORT semantics.

label: Lo2 cannot silently rewrite truth
statement: Learning/evolution may propose versioned candidates but cannot silently mutate authoritative laws/kernels.

label: Reasoning is bounded
statement: Reasoning must obey declared time/context/resource/domain bounds and predefined timeout behavior.

label: Fail-safe dominates intelligence
statement: Safety and integrity blocks dominate model confidence, decision preference and presentation.

label: No single unverified authority
statement: Where independent verification is required, no single model/sensor/assertion can independently authorize factual or executable truth.

label: One authoritative final output
statement: A task may expose only one legal authoritative final output; unresolved alternatives remain internal or cause freeze/silence.

label: Swarm is not final authority
statement: SWARM/agents produce candidate work/evidence but cannot directly commit final truth or write authoritative Vault state.

label: UI cannot create truth
statement: UI/presentation state cannot lower verification thresholds, mutate canonical truth, mask FREEZE or substitute for backend authorization.

label: Uncertainty cannot silently inflate
statement: Uncertainty, missing evidence and contradiction state must propagate until new proof legitimately resolves them.

label: Unverified output never releases
statement: No candidate crosses final release boundary without required verification, LAW and release-policy gates.

label: Robot safety overrides AI
statement: Independent robot safety/kill/watchdog authority must override ordinary AI/control output.

label: REQ-CONST-001
statement: Constitutional integrity shall take precedence over availability when the two conflict.

label: REQ-CONST-002
statement: Regional override authority shall use a fixed five-region model with 3/5 threshold in the locked source branch.

label: REQ-CONST-003
statement: Time authority shall use a three-member TSA set with 2-of-3 valid signatures.

label: REQ-CONST-004
statement: Degraded time operation shall be bounded; after the locked degraded window, anchor mutation freezes.

label: REQ-CONST-005
statement: Anchor publication shall follow PROPOSED→QUORUM_SIGNED→MERKLE_UPDATED→CHAIN_ANCHORED→IPFS_PINNED→MIRROR_REPLICATED→FINALIZED.

label: REQ-CONST-006
statement: Empty anchor intervals shall still produce an anchored empty batch/root in the source design.

label: REQ-CONST-007
statement: Immutable core detection shall detect signature failure, Merkle divergence, hash discontinuity, invalid TSA/quorum and key-reuse anomalies.

label: REQ-CONST-008
statement: Extendable detection modules shall not suppress core detection or alter immutable core thresholds.

label: REQ-CONST-009
statement: Core, Universe, and Quarantine authority/isolation planes shall remain separated.

label: REQ-CONST-010
statement: Universe runtime shall not share mutable memory with Core, mount parent Core filesystem, spawn privileged containers, self-escalate resources, or mutate sealed spec.

label: REQ-CONST-011
statement: A violating universe shall be containable locally without freezing unrelated universes when global integrity is not implicated.

label: REQ-CONST-012
statement: Host survival controls shall operate outside the user Universe and prioritize Core/Vault/Guardian survival under resource pressure.

label: REQ-CONST-013
statement: Deterministic resurrection shall verify host cleanliness, snapshot/state hash and build hash before legal replay/restart.

label: REQ-CONST-014
statement: Auto-recovery shall freeze/state-lock the universe, release resources, record recovery marker, then restart in safe runtime only after checks/cooldown.

label: REQ-CONST-015
statement: Builder shall canonicalize AppSpec and bind build/deploy identity to SHA-256 SpecHash.

label: REQ-CONST-016
statement: Reproducible build envelope shall pin compiler/toolchain/container/environment inputs and normalize time/locale/path-sensitive sources.

label: REQ-CONST-017
statement: Cross-universe access shall require explicit grant identifying source, destination, scope, rate, expiry and signatures.

label: REQ-CONST-018
statement: Creator apps shall declare network/storage/SDK/cross-app/economy/public capabilities in sealed spec.

label: REQ-CONST-019
statement: Creator publication shall require CREATED→BUILT→SEALED→VALIDATED→ANCHOR_QUEUED→FINALIZED→PUBLIC_ACTIVE and not be public before FINALIZED.

label: REQ-CONST-020
statement: Creator resource soft breach shall use graceful shutdown path; hard breach shall kill offending app while preserving Kernel.

label: REQ-CONST-021
statement: Recursive app creation shall increase tier monotonically and enforce maximum depth 5.

label: REQ-CONST-022
statement: Child capability/resource/permission set shall be a subset of parent and shall not escalate CPU/network/storage/SDK authority.

label: REQ-CONST-023
statement: Major constitutional change shall occur through explicit major version/fork rather than in-place silent mutation.

label: REQ-CONST-024
statement: Canonical Core mutation shall have exactly one deterministic mutator/executor and no parallel shared mutable canonical state.

label: REQ-CONST-025
statement: Canonical async/event processing shall use explicit FIFO ordering with monotonic counter and no dynamic priority.

label: REQ-CONST-026
statement: Canonical Core arithmetic shall avoid floating point/system clock/RNG and use locked integer/fixed semantics; Core overflow freezes.

label: REQ-CONST-027
statement: Canonical environment shall lock timezone/locale/path/target/allocator inputs into build identity.

label: REQ-CONST-028
statement: Canonical mutation shall serialize event→append WAL→fsync→mutate memory→ACK.

label: REQ-CONST-029
statement: WAL entries shall use canonical binary schema/endianness, length prefix, monotonic counter, previous-state/event/spec/signature hashes and per-entry SHA-256.

label: REQ-CONST-030
statement: Canonical snapshot creation shall freeze→serialize→hash→write→fsync→resume and use two-phase commit before activation.

label: REQ-CONST-031
statement: Boot recovery shall verify build/environment, load latest valid snapshot, replay WAL strictly and recompute state hash after each entry.

label: REQ-CONST-032
statement: Critical storage path shall use approved durable device/filesystem/barrier/kernel/scheduler semantics and attested storage identity.

label: REQ-CONST-033
statement: State-changing human actions shall be finite, explicit, signed, replayable and auditable; ad-hoc production force mutation is prohibited.

label: REQ-CONST-034
statement: Destructive actions such as region eviction, emergency anchor replacement, major upgrade/fork trigger shall require dual authorization/signature as specified.

label: REQ-DOC-C-API-001
statement: All mutating routes shall require secure session and CSRF except OTAC request/verify routes.

label: REQ-DOC-C-API-002
statement: Mutating routes shall require an idempotency key unless explicitly exempted by contract.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-001
statement: OTAC length shall be 10 alphanumeric characters under current canonical defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-002
statement: OTAC TTL shall be 5 minutes under later canonical DOC-C defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-003
statement: OTAC shall be single-use and stored as a hash rather than plaintext.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-004
statement: OTAC attempts shall be limited to 5 with 60s resend cooldown and 15min lock window.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-005
statement: Session TTL shall be 6h and concurrent sessions/user limited to 5 under later canonical pack.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-006
statement: Secure session cookie shall be HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/ and rotate on successful verification.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-007
statement: Session renewal shall occur only through explicit refresh behavior and shall not silently extend forever.

label: REQ-DOC-C-AUTH-008
statement: Device mismatch, reused OTAC, revoked-session reuse or suspicious rapid retry shall deny session and emit security/audit evidence.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONFIG-001
statement: Schema version, dependency rules and state-machine definition shall be immutable at runtime.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONFIG-002
statement: Threshold/agent/timeout/quorum/auth-limit changes shall require config version, actor, audit record and rollback target.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONTRACT-001
statement: All API responses shall use the canonical SystemEnvelope.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONTRACT-002
statement: Directive requests shall carry canonical identity/input/mode/priority/constraints/metadata including idempotency context.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONTRACT-003
statement: Evidence shall be represented as a first-class structured object with source, hash, confidence, verification and provenance metadata.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONTRACT-004
statement: ConsensusResult shall record acceptance/releaseability/output/scores/agents/evidence/thresholds/decision reason/conflict state.

label: REQ-DOC-C-CONTRACT-005
statement: ReleasePolicyResult shall record pass/fail, exact threshold snapshot and reasons.

label: REQ-DOC-C-ENV-001
statement: Provider/API secrets shall remain server-side and be injected at runtime; frontend shall not contain real provider secrets.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-001
statement: FREEZE shall block output release and new non-owner execution.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-002
statement: Entering FREEZE shall create or link a primary FreezeIncident.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-003
statement: Entering FREEZE shall invalidate any pending release token/output authorization.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-004
statement: STOP shall cancel all queue jobs and require manual/admin intervention.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-005
statement: When multiple failures occur, primary failure priority shall be security breach > schema violation > illegal transition > consensus failure > timeout.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FREEZE-006
statement: Recovery shall purge pending output and shall not resume the old queue job; it starts a new execution cycle.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-001
statement: Execution FSM shall permit INIT + boot → READY.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-002
statement: Execution FSM shall permit READY + execute → RUNNING when directive/system guards pass.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-003
statement: RUNNING + agents_done shall transition to VERIFYING when results exist.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-004
statement: VERIFYING + verified shall transition to CONSENSUS when evidence is valid.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-005
statement: CONSENSUS + accepted shall transition to STABLE only when quorum and release policy pass.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-006
statement: CONSENSUS + rejected shall transition to FREEZE.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-007
statement: Error from any non-STOP execution state shall transition to FREEZE according to failure priority.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-008
statement: FREEZE + recover may return to READY only when recovery is allowed and actor is OWNER or SYSTEM.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-009
statement: FREEZE + fatal shall transition to STOP; STOP shall not transition to operational states.

label: REQ-DOC-C-FSM-010
statement: Every execution-state transition shall emit traceable event metadata.

label: REQ-DOC-C-MOD-001
statement: API may depend on AUTH and CORE, but AUTH shall not depend on CORE.

label: REQ-DOC-C-MOD-002
statement: UI shall not directly depend on LAW or VAULT.

label: REQ-DOC-C-MOD-003
statement: SWARM shall not write directly to VAULT.

label: REQ-DOC-C-MOD-004
statement: JUDGE shall not call back into CORE as a reverse authority dependency.

label: REQ-DOC-C-MOD-005
statement: LAW shall not depend on UI.

label: REQ-DOC-C-OBS-001
statement: Operational events, accountable actions, security incidents and freeze incidents shall remain distinct record classes with traceable links.

label: REQ-DOC-C-QUEUE-001
statement: Queue payload shall be validated before enqueue and revalidated before consume.

label: REQ-DOC-C-QUEUE-002
statement: Queue job lifecycle shall be QUEUED/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED with stale jobs expiring.

label: REQ-DOC-C-QUEUE-003
statement: Current stale-job TTL shall be 15min and maximum concurrent pipeline runs 10.

label: REQ-DOC-C-QUEUE-004
statement: Failed jobs shall not automatically retry unless explicitly classified safe.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RBAC-001
statement: Backend shall enforce role permissions independently of UI visibility.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-001
statement: Release shall require accepted=true and releaseable=true.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-002
statement: Release confidence shall meet or exceed confidence_min=0.85 under current canonical defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-003
statement: Deterministic-match score shall meet or exceed 0.90 under current canonical defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-004
statement: Current release quorum minimum shall be 2.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-005
statement: Current verified-evidence minimum shall be 2.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-006
statement: Release shall require no critical-agent blocking failure, no authoritative FREEZE, integrity hash present, and LAW pre-release pass.

label: REQ-DOC-C-RELEASE-007
statement: Unresolved agent conflict shall not be resolved by averaging or guessing.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SCOPE-001
statement: Current vNEXT build shall include directive execution, multi-agent verify/consensus, release policy, Vault revisioning, OTAC auth, RBAC, observability, queue/idempotency, UI truth, owner controls and auditability.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SCOPE-002
statement: Voice orchestration, AR/VR/XR, holographic UI, blockchain, IoT, quantum-safe layer, self-patch/auto-heal runtime and public anonymous write access shall remain outside current vNEXT scope unless spec is explicitly extended.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SCOPE-003
statement: Any feature outside DOC-C include list shall require explicit spec extension, impact review, and version bump before becoming build obligation.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-001
statement: Each AgentAdapter shall declare provider/id/schema version, modes, deterministic capability, criticality, timeout, context capacity and execute/cancel/health behavior.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-002
statement: Agent health shall expose HEALTHY, DEGRADED or UNHEALTHY plus latency.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-003
statement: Current multi-AI pipeline shall execute Decompose→Parallel Execution→Adversarial Check→Cross Verification→Consensus Evaluation→Emit or Freeze.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-004
statement: Decomposition timeout shall be 5 seconds under current defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-005
statement: Agent timeout shall remain within configured 10–60s range; default and critical timeout are 30s.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-006
statement: Cross-verification timeout shall be 15s and consensus timeout 10s under current defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-007
statement: Global pipeline cap shall be 120 seconds under current canonical defaults.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-008
statement: Automatic retry shall be disabled by default unless a retry is explicitly classified safe.

label: REQ-DOC-C-SWARM-009
statement: A noncritical agent timeout may exclude that worker only if quorum/release policy can still pass; a critical agent timeout shall block/freeze.

label: REQ-DOC-C-TEST-001
statement: Required test gates shall include contract/API schema/FSM/dependency/LAW/release/freeze/auth-abuse/Vault/migration/RBAC/queue-idempotency coverage.

label: REQ-DOC-C-TEST-002
statement: Coverage targets shall be at least 90% for domain/core/law/judge and 85% for API; critical UI flows require E2E.

label: REQ-DOC-C-UI-001
statement: UI shall reflect backend truth and shall not invent success, mask FREEZE, or expose partial output as released.

label: REQ-DOC-C-UI-002
statement: Freeze screen shall expose primary incident, trigger/blocking layer/recoverability and only show recovery CTA to permitted owner role.

label: REQ-DOC-C-UI-003
statement: Loading skeleton/animation shall indicate request-in-flight only and shall not imply success.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VALID-001
statement: Runtime validation shall occur at each trust boundary, not only at TypeScript compile time.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VALID-002
statement: Internal data shall not be trusted solely because it originated from another NEXY module.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-001
statement: Vault lineage shall preserve User→Project→Artifact→Revision→Commit relationships.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-002
statement: Every content mutation shall create a new monotonically numbered Revision; committed revision body shall be immutable.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-003
statement: Commit shall point to exactly one existing revision and enforce previous_version optimistic concurrency plus idempotency.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-004
statement: Metadata shall be stored transactionally while large content may reside in object/blob storage with content hash/path linkage.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-005
statement: Project/Artifact ordinary deletion shall be soft-delete with lineage retained; restore only when parent/lineage/blob conditions remain valid.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-006
statement: Hard delete shall be irreversible, OWNER-only, audited, and remove blob/reference according to policy.

label: REQ-DOC-C-VAULT-007
statement: Redaction/derived views shall not rewrite original audit lineage.

label: REQ-DOC-D-001
statement: Front Door shall present a minimal primary entry with mode selection and no dangerous/telemetry clutter by default.

label: REQ-DOC-D-002
statement: Directive Create shall expose input, mode, priority, allow_external and deterministic_required fields and keep submit disabled until schema-valid.

label: REQ-DOC-D-003
statement: Freeze Incident surface shall visibly show FREEZE, primary incident code, trigger, blocking layer and recoverable flag.

label: REQ-DOC-D-004
statement: Owner controls such as recover/revoke/config shall be role-gated and backend-authorized.

label: REQ-DOC-D-005
statement: I-Don't-Know mode may show examples or ask one guided question but shall not invent missing material facts.

label: REQ-DOC-D-006
statement: Mobile layout should remain single-column, tables may collapse to cards, and freeze banner remains sticky; desktop should avoid more than two main panels by default.

label: REQ-DOC-D-007
statement: Pending/loading visuals shall appear only while waiting for backend truth and shall not imply successful completion.

label: REQ-DOC-D-008
statement: Empty states should explicitly identify absence such as no directive/revision/incident/run rather than fabricate placeholder records.

label: REQ-DOC-D-009
statement: Onboarding/trust loop should explain one-output semantics, FREEZE as integrity behavior, available modes and why actions are blocked.

label: REQ-DOC-D-010
statement: UI visibility may reduce confusion but shall never substitute for backend authorization.

label: REQ-DOC-D-AUTH-001
statement: Logout shall revoke current session; revoke-all shall revoke every user session; revoked session shall not reactivate.

label: REQ-DOC-D-AUTH-002
statement: When concurrent session limit is exceeded, policy shall revoke the oldest non-owner session first; owner-session removal requires explicit confirmation in product hardening source.

label: REQ-DOC-D-AUTH-003
statement: OTAC request/verify success/failure, logout, revoke-all and suspicious login shall emit auditable auth events.

label: REQ-DOC-D-AUTH-004
statement: Owner account/session recovery shall require explicit manual recovery path with security incident and audit trail; no hidden bypass.

label: REQ-DOC-D-AUTH-005
statement: Authentication metadata shall be minimized to security-relevant fields such as device ID, IP hash, summarized user-agent and timestamps; unnecessary profiling shall not be stored.

label: REQ-DOC-D-STORAGE-001
statement: Vault commit shall validate request/revision/previous_version/content hash, execute metadata transaction, record blob verification marker and audit action atomically where specified.

label: REQ-DOC-D-STORAGE-002
statement: Artifact restore shall require soft-deleted artifact, active parent project, intact lineage and non-hard-deleted referenced blob.

label: REQ-DOC-D-STORAGE-003
statement: Blob retention/archive tiers may use hot/warm/cold storage but shall preserve traceability and active revision references.

label: REQ-DOC-E-001
statement: Deployment evidence pack shall contain a contract-test report for the exact release build.

label: REQ-DOC-E-002
statement: Deployment evidence pack shall contain current API schema snapshot.

label: REQ-DOC-E-003
statement: Migration shall be applied and rollback actually executed/tested on target-like environment before deployment approval.

label: REQ-DOC-E-004
statement: State-machine test report shall prove current legal/illegal transitions for release build.

label: REQ-DOC-E-005
statement: RBAC test report shall prove privileged/denied actions for release build.

label: REQ-DOC-E-006
statement: Auth-abuse simulation shall exercise invalid/expired/reused OTAC, attempt exhaustion, cooldown, lock, device mismatch, revoked session, CSRF and rate-limit behavior.

label: REQ-DOC-E-007
statement: Queue-worker readiness proof shall demonstrate enqueue, consume, invalid payload handling, stale expiry and idempotency duplicate blocking.

label: REQ-DOC-E-008
statement: Monitoring/alarm verification shall exercise auth abuse, freeze incident, worker down, queue backlog, DB failure and release-policy failure alerts.

label: REQ-DOC-E-009
statement: Incident drill shall demonstrate incident IDs, event/audit/security/freeze linkage, containment/recovery actions and final outcome.

label: REQ-DOC-E-010
statement: Deploy runbook shall contain exact install/migrate/seed/queue/API/web/health/smoke/log/freeze/deploy/rollback commands for target environment.

label: REQ-DOC-E-011
statement: Release signoff shall include engineering, security, migration, rollback and monitoring verification approval.

label: REQ-DOC-E-012
statement: Rollback playbook shall have execution proof rather than documentation-only claim.

label: REQ-DOC-E-013
statement: Release environment shall prove a blocking condition reaches FREEZE, blocks output, renders truthful UI/API state, links incident and only legally recovers.

label: REQ-DOC-E-014
statement: Every deployment proof artifact shall bind to exact build/commit/environment it proves.

label: REQ-DOC-E-015
statement: Deployment status shall remain NON-DEPLOYABLE until required DOC-E proof artifacts for current release exist and pass.

label: REQ-FINAL-001
statement: No raw input shall enter authoritative reasoning without normalization/noise handling/confidence context.

label: REQ-FINAL-002
statement: Context/Intent resolution shall resolve explicit intent/constraints/risk without inventing missing material intent.

label: REQ-FINAL-003
statement: Constraint Law Engine shall represent/enforce safety, logical, resource and temporal constraints as executable gates.

label: REQ-FINAL-004
statement: Uncertainty/proof tier/missing evidence/contradiction state shall propagate input→reasoning→decision→action without silent certainty inflation.

label: REQ-FINAL-005
statement: Every deep reasoning path shall have explicit time/resource bound and predefined timeout outcome.

label: REQ-FINAL-006
statement: Factual/executable authority shall not depend solely on one unverified sensor/model/assertion where source requires independent verification.

label: REQ-FINAL-007
statement: Safety > Decision > Intelligence shall hold across execution; model confidence cannot override safety/integrity blocks.

label: REQ-FINAL-008
statement: Risk/intelligence status should distinguish NORMAL, CAUTION, UNCERTAIN, CRITICAL and FAILSAFE and shall remain separate from other FSM namespaces.

label: REQ-FINAL-009
statement: NEXY shall not depend on perfect knowledge, zero error or infinite reasoning assumptions.

label: REQ-FINAL-010
statement: Adaptive learning shall preserve experimental separation, conflict handling, provenance and versioned promotion.

label: REQ-FINAL-011
statement: Design/spec presence shall remain distinct from implementation, runtime, deployment and physical proof in all status reporting.

label: REQ-GAME-001
statement: Game Fabric shall separate nondeterministic render/gameplay presentation from deterministic sovereign state authority.

label: REQ-GAME-002
statement: Every deployed game shall declare GameSpec including engine/physics/RNG/network/tick/resources/public mode and bind it to SpecHash.

label: REQ-GAME-003
statement: Game updates shall use freeze→rebuild→new spec hash→redeploy; hot patch/live code injection is prohibited.

label: REQ-GAME-004
statement: Core anti-cheat authority shall focus on ledger/spec/cross-universe/permission integrity rather than policing all ordinary gameplay cheats.

label: REQ-GAME-005
statement: Game/app-local value may exist, but conversion/settlement to constitutional value shall follow deterministic declared formulas and constitutional invariants.

label: REQ-GAME-006
statement: Each authoritative shard shall use fixed tick, deterministic simulation and per-tick state hash.

label: REQ-GAME-007
statement: Region authority shall derive region root as Merkle over shard hashes.

label: REQ-GAME-008
statement: Client shall never be authoritative; it sends input events and receives authoritative state/deltas.

label: REQ-GAME-009
statement: Cross-shard movement shall use EXPORT→COMMIT→IMPORT at deterministic boundaries with finalized root/signature/snapshot validation.

label: REQ-GAME-010
statement: Value-bearing cross-shard entities shall bind economic-state hash and commit ledger state before export.

label: REQ-GAME-011
statement: Asset/toolchain builds shall use canonical ordering, pinned tools/environment and cross-architecture hash equality.

label: REQ-GAME-012
statement: Authoritative simulation shall not use floating point and shall use locked fixed-point/canonical numeric/order semantics; source selects Q64.64.

label: REQ-GAME-013
statement: World topology shall use fixed grid/chunk size, deterministic activation/deactivation/load ordering and tick-boundary world changes.

label: REQ-GAME-014
statement: Authoritative AI/crowd updates shall use canonical perception/path/agent order, fixed iteration and deterministic budgets.

label: REQ-GAME-015
statement: Networking shall be an ordered tick-indexed input conveyor with canonical schema/endianness/sequence and deterministic late/loss handling.

label: REQ-GAME-016
statement: Authoritative game nodes should attest approved CPU/microcode/kernel/storage environment and cross-check state hashes to detect hardware drift.

label: REQ-HIST-ARCHITECT-OVERRIDE-001
statement: Earlier Lo3 UX allowed the Architect to inject a hard rule mid-debate and redirect the swarm immediately.

label: REQ-HIST-AUTH-OTAC-TTL-001
statement: Earlier auth direction described OTAC TTL approximately 10–15 minutes.

label: REQ-HIST-AUTH-SESSION-TTL-001
statement: Earlier vNEXT.1 draft used a 30-day session TTL.

label: REQ-HIST-LO2-SILENT-UPDATE-001
statement: Earlier Lo2 vision allowed silent automatic updating of L1o/Lo3 kernels after law evolution.

label: REQ-HIST-LO3-VOTING-001
statement: Earlier Lo3 design described weighted voting/trust-score majority as consensus mechanism.

label: REQ-HIST-OUTPUT-ABSOLUTE-CONFIDENCE-001
statement: Earlier source language implied absolute/100% confidence as a release ideal.

label: REQ-HIST-TRUTH-ABSOLUTE-001
statement: Earlier source rhetoric expected absolute/100% truth behavior across reasoning.

label: REQ-L1O-001
statement: L1o shall produce only bounded/provable outputs relative to explicit constraints rather than claim universal perfect truth.

label: REQ-L1O-002
statement: Raw input shall be canonicalized into semantic intent/constraints with explicit ambiguity signal before deeper L1o reasoning.

label: REQ-L1O-003
statement: Constraint Engine shall distinguish hard, soft and mechanically authorized derived constraints.

label: REQ-L1O-004
statement: L1o reasoning shall support dependency/state graph representation and recursive atomic node expansion.

label: REQ-L1O-005
statement: L1o shall generate multiple candidate paths and use entropy/pruning rather than committing to the first plausible path.

label: REQ-L1O-006
statement: Uncertain paths should be deprioritized rather than always destroyed when proof is incomplete.

label: REQ-L1O-007
statement: Recursive Self-Auditor shall independently recompute critical result and reject candidate when primary and independent result disagree.

label: REQ-L1O-008
statement: L1o audit should exercise null/extreme/race-style failure cases where applicable.

label: REQ-L1O-009
statement: Output Synthesizer may retain multiple internal candidates but final NEXY release shall still obey one-output-or-freeze law.

label: REQ-L1O-010
statement: L1o internal logic shall support symbolic/graph/state-machine transition representation S(t)→f→S(t+1).

label: REQ-L1O-011
statement: L1o shall distinguish runtime working memory from verified durable memory and experimental memory.

label: REQ-L1O-012
statement: Conflicting L1o memory shall branch/simulate/resolve rather than destructively overwrite verified history.

label: REQ-L1O-013
statement: Code-Brain should reason about memory/resource/layout/side-effects and generate normal/edge/failure tests for produced code.

label: REQ-L1O-014
statement: Certainty tiers T0–T4 shall remain explicit and shall not be collapsed into binary certain/uncertain semantics.

label: REQ-LO2-001
statement: Lo2 intake shall accept verified L1o/Lo3 experience and reject unverified raw input as law-learning material.

label: REQ-LO2-002
statement: Verified solutions shall be decomposed into Logic Units and extracted into reusable Logic Quanta/rules/invariants.

label: REQ-LO2-003
statement: Logic Quanta shall be cross-verified against comparable quanta/outcomes and contradictions forwarded to conflict resolution.

label: REQ-LO2-004
statement: Lo2 conflicts shall branch, simulate and evaluate proof/frequency/consistency/survivability rather than use raw majority deletion.

label: REQ-LO2-005
statement: Law synthesis shall combine multiple verified quanta into generalized candidate laws while retaining traceability.

label: REQ-LO2-006
statement: Law evolution may propose simplify/generalize/optimize mutations but authoritative runtime promotion shall remain versioned, verified and governed.

label: REQ-LO2-007
statement: USL shall preserve laws/quanta with origin, verification and ancestry provenance.

label: REQ-LO2-008
statement: Distribution of evolved intelligence to L1o/Lo3 shall support versioned release and rollback rather than hidden mutation.

label: REQ-LO2-009
statement: Lo2 shall defend against fake success, biased patterns and adversarial logic using multi-source verification, survival over time and adversarial testing.

label: REQ-LO2-010
statement: Lo2 should generalize specific verified solutions into reusable abstract rules without losing governing constraints.

label: REQ-LO2-011
statement: Lo2 shall distinguish law, quanta, experimental and deprecated memory classes.

label: REQ-LO2-012
statement: Lo2 intelligence growth shall be driven by verified quality/diversity rather than raw user-count or raw-data volume alone.

label: REQ-LO3-001
statement: Lo3 task decomposition shall continue until work units are measurable, testable and verifiable.

label: REQ-LO3-002
statement: Lo3 shall support context sharding/independent worker context to reduce correlated hallucination and answer-copying.

label: REQ-LO3-003
statement: Agent orchestration shall consider model capabilities/weaknesses/cost/trust while keeping workers non-authoritative.

label: REQ-LO3-004
statement: External/model proposals shall be treated as untrusted candidates carrying answer/reasoning/confidence metadata.

label: REQ-LO3-005
statement: Lo3 adversarial engine shall attack candidates through logical, data, constraint and mutation challenges within bounded rounds.

label: REQ-LO3-006
statement: Consensus shall use proof-weighted/adversarial-survival evidence rather than ordinary majority voting alone.

label: REQ-LO3-007
statement: Final Lo3 candidate shall be independently verified through deterministic rerun, constraint validation, simulation or domain-appropriate test.

label: REQ-LO3-008
statement: Lo3 Output Controller shall distinguish verified result, multiple candidates, insufficient proof and conflict detected states.

label: REQ-LO3-009
statement: Lo3 should inject heterogeneous optimization perspectives to reduce synchronized bias.

label: REQ-LO3-010
statement: Lo3 should preserve governed failure/attack patterns for reuse against similar future tasks.

label: REQ-LO3-011
statement: Lo3 should route cheap/expensive models and early-kill failed candidates to bound cost without weakening required proof.

label: REQ-LO3-012
statement: External model interaction shall be treated as untrusted and constrained by prompt-law/security/isolation controls.

label: REQ-NCF-001
statement: NCF may use nondeterministic creation, but deployable artifacts shall be canonicalized, hashed, sealed and deterministic at authority boundary.

label: REQ-NCF-002
statement: Every deployable NCF artifact shall have ArtifactSpec covering identity/runtime/assets/code/dependencies/resources/permissions.

label: REQ-NCF-003
statement: AI-generated artifact output shall pass canonical intermediate representation and relevant AST/spec/dependency validation before seal.

label: REQ-NCF-004
statement: Sealed artifact shall be immutable; modification creates a new build/spec/artifact identity.

label: REQ-NCF-005
statement: Capability registry shall be global/versioned/append-only and capability node/version shall be immutable after activation.

label: REQ-NCF-006
statement: Capability activation shall follow PROPOSED→REVIEWED→QUORUM_SIGNED→ANCHORED→ACTIVE with no retroactive activation.

label: REQ-NCF-007
statement: Universe capability envelope shall include exact ACTIVE versions, dependency closure, conflict/determinism/resource/permission validation and deterministic EnvelopeHash.

label: REQ-NCF-008
statement: Capability deterministic classes shall constrain where a node may participate; NONDET_RENDER shall not mutate sovereign state and SANDBOXED shall remain confined.

label: REQ-NCF-009
statement: Capability admission shall require both deterministic static verification and fixed-quorum human policy review.

label: REQ-NCF-010
statement: Static verifier shall check canonical schema, dependency closure, forbidden collisions, deterministic class, resource/syscall/network/code-loading and authority-escalation rules.

label: REQ-NCF-011
statement: Human policy reviewer shall evaluate policy-risk dimensions and may ACCEPT/REJECT but not rewrite CapabilityNode.

label: REQ-NCF-012
statement: Governance rejection shall use active machine-readable reason codes; free text alone shall not be authoritative rejection reason.

label: REQ-NCF-013
statement: Rejection reason-code registry shall be append-only; codes may be deprecated but not redefined/deleted.

label: REQ-NCF-014
statement: Public registry projection shall permit governance/root/dependency/rejection replay while hiding infrastructure topology, private exploit material and sensitive reviewer metadata.

label: REQ-NCF-015
statement: Chaos tests shall run in isolated deterministic fork and shall not mutate production registry, real CSU ledger or production shard state.

label: REQ-NCF-016
statement: Chaos execution shall use fixed scenario/seed/tick inputs and produce reproducible ChaosResultHash.

label: REQ-NCF-017
statement: Chaos shall test ledger boundedness, no double credit/state divergence/recursion overflow/governance bypass/cross-shard duplication/unbounded acceleration as applicable.

label: REQ-NCF-018
statement: Chaos invariant failure shall not be silently patched; it shall surface failure hash and require governed repair/fork path.

label: REQ-RCL-001
statement: Robotics shall separate immediate Fast Path reflex from deeper Safe Path AI reasoning.

label: REQ-RCL-002
statement: Raw sensors shall be fused/normalized with confidence/uncertainty before L1o/Lo3 decision logic.

label: REQ-RCL-003
statement: Fast Path shall use bounded/precomputed safety/reflex rules and shall not require a full L1o/Lo3 cycle.

label: REQ-RCL-004
statement: Safe Path shall run bounded L1o plus bounded mini-Lo3/simulation/constraint checks within declared deadline.

label: REQ-RCL-005
statement: Independent Safety Kernel shall be able to override ordinary AI/control decisions for collision/force/boundary/emergency-stop conditions.

label: REQ-RCL-006
statement: Real-time Lo3 should be constrained to small critical swarm/attack-round counts suitable for control deadlines.

label: REQ-RCL-007
statement: Sensor failure shall select only predefined safe backup behavior; decision timeout shall select legal safe fallback; no safe action shall STOP and alert.

label: REQ-RCL-008
statement: Safety MCU shall remain independent of the high-level AI/ROS path in the proposed physical architecture.

label: REQ-RCL-009
statement: Physical emergency stop and watchdog/redundant stop mechanisms shall exist in real physical deployment before physical safety claims.

label: REQ-RCL-010
statement: Main robotics stack should use explicit communication boundaries such as ROS2 DDS and UART/CAN to MCUs as designed.

label: REQ-RCL-011
statement: Robotics implementation status shall not be claimed from source/code alone; physical claims require HIL/physical evidence appropriate to the claim.

label: REQ-SEC-001
statement: All external/user/provider input shall be treated as untrusted until validated at the appropriate boundary.

label: REQ-SEC-002
statement: Permitted code/tool execution shall occur in a sandbox appropriate to its authority and shall block RCE/privilege escalation into protected layers.

label: REQ-SEC-003
statement: Secrets shall be server-side, runtime-injected and excluded from source/client output/logs where not required.

label: REQ-SEC-004
statement: Critical actions shall create immutable/auditable trace records sufficient to reconstruct actor/action/target/result.

label: REQ-SEC-005
statement: Authentication and public API boundaries shall enforce rate/abuse controls.

label: REQ-SEC-006
statement: Detected integrity/security breach shall be containable and may freeze/deny affected execution according to severity.

label: REQ-SLAW-001
statement: NEXY shall operate as a deterministic AI control hub rather than a presentation-only chatbot/AGI authority.

label: REQ-SLAW-002
statement: USER LAW shall be enforceable by downstream authoritative components.

label: REQ-SLAW-003
statement: SWARM may perform work but shall not become final truth authority over CORE/JUDGE.

label: REQ-SLAW-004
statement: Human Gravity/presentation behavior shall not mutate Core state or lower truth/verification thresholds.

label: REQ-SLAW-005
statement: One task shall have one controlled released final output.

label: REQ-SLAW-006
statement: Unresolved ambiguity, insufficient evidence, unresolved contradiction, policy conflict, or undefined behavior shall block authoritative release.

label: REQ-SLAW-007
statement: Only verified output may cross the final release boundary.

label: REQ-SLAW-008
statement: Raw or uncertain input shall not silently become certain authoritative reasoning input.

label: REQ-SLAW-009
statement: Reasoning shall be bounded by explicit time/context/resource/domain limits.

label: REQ-SLAW-010
statement: Safety and integrity shall dominate decision and raw intelligence.
